WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(p.throws, '') as throws, COUNT(*) as award_count
  FROM player_award pa
  JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.throws, '')
),
hand_shares AS (
  SELECT throws, award_count, 
    award_count * 1.0 / SUM(award_count) OVER () as share
  FROM hand_counts
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM hand_shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT throws, award_count, share, (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as avg_share_val
  FROM hand_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(award_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - avg_share_val) as avg_excess
FROM above_average
